String.name: IDS_FD_Suspension_Description
String.en: Based on 16 Formula Drift cars, with spring and damping rates adapted to this car's axle loads. Preserves native chassis geometry. Includes adjustable suspension and 60-degree steering when equipped.
String.zh: 依前後軸負載調校的漂移彈簧與避震器，內側前輪的最大轉向角可達 60°。

String.name: IDS_PS1_SLR_AngleKit_Desc
String.en: Adjustable drift springs and dampers with up to 74° of inside front-wheel steering lock.
String.zh: 可調校的漂移彈簧與避震器，內側前輪的最大轉向角可達 74°。
